instruction: Set Thunderbird's minimum font size to 16px to improve text clarity and accessibility in emails.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting a minimum font size for better readability in Thunderbird. The evaluator verifies that font.minimum-size.x-western preference is set to 16 pixels. This preference controls the minimum font size for Western character sets in Thunderbird, helping users with visual accessibility needs.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly downloads Thunderbird prefs.js file from the correct path (/home/user/.thunderbird/t5q2a5hp.default-release/prefs.js)
Metric correctly parses Thunderbird preference format using regex pattern for 'user_pref("key", value);' format
Expected value is semantically correct: font.minimum-size.x-western set to 16 is the correct Thunderbird preference for setting minimum font size to 16 pixels
Evaluator fully covers the instruction requirement: verifies that minimum font size is set to 16 pixels
Metric correctly handles None case when getter fails to download file
Postconfig appropriately closes Thunderbird window to ensure clean state before file read
Data flow is correct: getter returns file path, metric receives path and rules dict, comparison uses 'eq' method for exact match
